label: Fax-friendly shading on documents you send

where_it_saves: Faxbot keeps shaded areas with a fax-friendly pattern when that makes the call cost less, or when a fax must go by its send-by time or others are waiting for your phone line. Text and marks stay exactly as they are.
always: Faxbot keeps shaded areas with a fax-friendly pattern on every document whose pages it makes, whenever that shortens the call. Text and marks stay exactly as they are.
never: Faxbot sends the pages of your documents as they are.

whiten.label: Also make light areas white
whiten.warning: This may erase pale text and light marks, such as faint handwriting, and removes specks.

help: Shaded table rows, tinted form fields and highlights take most of a page's time on the line. Faxbot draws their inside with fine stripes that the fax line sends quickly and leaves every letter, line and mark exactly as it was: in Faxbot's tests a page with a shaded table went from 61 to 27 seconds, and pale text stayed as it was.
whiten_help: Light shading then prints white where that makes the call cost less; in Faxbot's tests a shaded table went from 61 to 12 seconds. This may erase pale text and light marks, such as faint handwriting, and removes specks.
